map.低浓、中浓、高浓怎么划分？: How are low, medium and high concentration defined?
map.储浆池稀释/浓缩时，按目标绝干率反算需加水量或蒸发量。: When diluting or concentrating the storage tank, work back from the target oven-dry content to get the water to add or to evaporate.
map.常见口径：<3% 低浓，3%–10% 中浓，>10% 高浓（部分文献以 8% 或: Common convention: <3% low concentration, 3%-10% medium, >10% high (some literature uses 8% or 10% as the cut-off). This tool uses 3% / 10%; follow your own internal control standard.
map.打浆与配浆工段，需由绝干率(%)和体积(L)核算体积浓度(g/L)，控制上网浓度: In the pulping and blending section the volumetric concentration (g/L) must be derived from the oven-dry content (%) and the volume (L) to control the concentration feeding the paper machine.

map.纸浆浓度计算 使用指南: How to use the pulp consistency calculator
map.质量浓度(%)和体积浓度(g/L)有何区别？: What is the difference between mass concentration (%) and volumetric concentration (g/L)?
map.质量浓度=绝干纤维÷浆料总质量（%），体积浓度=绝干纤维÷浆料体积（g/L）。同: Mass concentration = oven-dry fibre / total slurry mass (%), volumetric concentration = oven-dry fibre / slurry volume (g/L). At the same dry mass, volume changes caused by refining degree and temperature make the two figures diverge, so the blend should follow whichever one the process standard specifies.
map.质量浓度与体积浓度混用时，统一以绝干纤维量(kg)为桥梁避免出错。: When mixing mass and volumetric concentration, use the oven-dry fibre mass (kg) as the bridge to avoid mistakes.
map.输入湿浆质量、绝干率、浆料体积与目标浓度，计算绝干纤维量、质量浓度、体积浓度（g: Enter the wet pulp mass, oven-dry content, slurry volume and target concentration to compute the oven-dry fibre mass, the mass concentration, the volumetric concentration (g/L) and the water needed for dilution or concentration.
map.：稀释后总质量=绝干纤维÷目标%=100÷3%=3333.33 kg；需加水=3: : total mass after dilution = oven-dry fibre / target% = 100/3% = 3333.33 kg; water to add = 3333.33-500 = 2833.33 kg. Formula: final mass = dry mass / (target%/100), water added = final mass - original mass.
map.：绝干纤维量=500×20%=100.00 kg；体积浓度=100×1000/4: : oven-dry fibre = 500x20% = 100.00 kg; volumetric concentration = 100x1000/480≈208.3 g/L; a 20% oven-dry content counts as "high concentration" (>10%). Formula: volumetric concentration = oven-dry fibre (kg) x 1000 / volume (L).
